question: What is the value of (cos(50^circ +A)-sin(40^circ -A))/(cos40^circ sec40^circ)?
solution:
Given:

(cos(50^circ +A)-sin(40^circ -A))/(cos40^circ sec40^circ)

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a87da85ec536fedc8ec75aebc4d5f6ad3214d1d441d9a9b5c534cfa69c95dbb2.png] 

Calculation:

(cos(50^circ +A)-sin(40^circ -A))/(cos40^circ sec40^circ)

⇒ (sin(90 - (50^circ +A))-sin(40^circ -A))/(cos40^circ sec40^circ)

⇒ (sin(40^circ-A)-sin(40^circ -A))/(cos40^circ sec40^circ)

⇒ 0

∴ The required answer is 0.
